items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including critical arbitrary code execution (CVE-2026-103849, CVSS 10.0), privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass issues. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for the issues addressed in this specific update.

items.title: BlockStrap: Magento and Adobe Commerce RCE
items.summary: A CVSS 10.0 Magento and Adobe Commerce flaw that gives unauthenticated attackers remote code execution via a template engine injection. Adobe fixed it in APSB26-153, but a manual patch is required, and new installs may remain vulnerable.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: This critical vulnerability affects Adobe Commerce B2B and allows unauthenticated code execution. It was addressed as part of the APSB26-153 security update.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This emergency security update resolves a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650) that could result in arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware of CVE-2026-75650 being exploited in the wild.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: Sansec discovered this zero-day vulnerability that gives unauthenticated attackers remote code execution by injecting malicious code into Magento's template system. Attacks started on September 4th, and Adobe published an emergency hotfix on September 7th.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including multiple unauthenticated issues. Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: PolyShell: Unrestricted File Upload in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical file upload flaw was fixed in APSB26-73 and added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog on October 27, 2026, indicating active exploitation. It allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files.

items.title: SessionReaper, unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical flaw discovered in August 2025 allows customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions. Active exploitation was observed starting October 22, 2026, with automated attacks hitting many stores.
